tools.name: get_prices
tools.description: Current USD price, 24h change, market cap and volume for coins, by id (e.g. "bitcoin") or symbol (e.g. "BTC").

tools.name: top_coins
tools.description: Coins ranked by market cap. Optional chain filter (e.g. "trac").

tools.name: get_coin
tools.description: One coin with its markets. Every market has a public source URL to check the number.

tools.name: search_coins
tools.description: Find coins by name, symbol or id.

tools.name: market_overview
tools.description: Total crypto market cap, 24h volume, BTC share, number of coins, top exchanges.

tools.name: ranking_rules
tools.description: How TraderMarketCap computes price, market cap and rank, and which coins are not listed and why.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_coin · Public sink: market_overview.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_coin · Public sink: market_overview

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
